prompts.task: Build Zod validation pipe for NestJS
prompts.template:
Implement a ZodValidationPipe for NestJS that:
- Validates request bodies against Zod schemas
- Transforms validated data (e.g., string to number)
- Returns structured 400 errors with field-level messages
- Works with class-validator DTOs as fallback

Available skills: {skills}
constraints: Extract field-level Zod errors into { field: message } format
Fallback to class-validator if no Zod schema provided

prompts.task: Create a sanitization pipe for XSS prevention
prompts.template:
Build a SanitizePipe that:
- Strips HTML tags from string inputs
- Trims whitespace
- Escapes special characters
- Can be applied at param/body/query level

Available skills: {skills}
constraints: Use DOMPurify or similar for HTML stripping
